tip_start_sale_body: Tap here to start a sale. Just scan the barcode and the price adds up for you.
tip_today_summary_body: This shows what you sold today. Check it each evening to see your takings.
tip_dash_latest_body: These are your most recent sales. Tap 'See all' to look back over past days.
tip_dash_compliance_body: This shows how ready your shop is for inspection. Tap it to see what still needs doing.
tip_dash_journey_body: This tracks your progress to a fully legal shop. Tap to continue the next step.
tip_sales_start_body: Tap here to ring up a sale — scan items and the total adds up for you.
tip_sales_today_body: See how much you've sold today, at a glance.
tip_sales_weekly_body: This chart shows your sales for each day this week, so you can spot your busy days.
tip_sales_top_body: These are the items selling the most this week. Keep them in stock!
tip_sales_history_body: Tap here to see every sale for any day you choose.
tip_sales_stats_body: Tap here for best- and worst-sellers, profit, and trends over a period you pick.
tip_inventory_body: Tap here to add products, count stock, and see what's running low.
tip_inv_products_body: Tap here to add products and set their prices and costs.
tip_inv_expiry_body: Tap here to see products close to their expiry date so nothing goes to waste.
tip_inv_counts_body: These numbers show your total products, what's low, and what's expiring.
tip_inv_stocktake_body: Tap here to count what's really on your shelves and fix any differences.
tip_inv_suppliers_body: Tap here to save who you buy from, so reordering is easy.
tip_stock_scan_body: Tap here to scan a barcode and jump straight to that product's stock.
tip_stock_search_body: Type a name or barcode here to jump straight to a product.
tip_stock_tabs_body: Switch between all items, low stock, and items expiring soon.
tip_stock_summary_body: These show your total products, low stock, out-of-stock, and expiring counts.
tip_sd_adjust_body: Use 'Add' when new stock arrives, and 'Remove' for damage or loss.
tip_sd_quick_body: Tap a common amount to fill it in fast, or type your own below.
tip_sd_batches_body: Add batches with their expiry dates here, so Movestock can warn you before they go off.
tip_product_add_body: Tap here to add a new product — give it a name, price, and barcode.
tip_products_import_body: Tap here to add common products quickly without typing everything.
tip_products_search_body: Type a name or barcode here to find a product in your list.
tip_products_row_body: Tap any product to change its name, price, cost, or stock.
tip_manage_staff_body: Tap here to add tellers and give each one a PIN to log in.
tip_manage_body: Tap here to see the steps to get your shop fully registered and legal.
tip_manage_compliance_body: Tap here to run through what an inspector would look for.
tip_manage_waste_pest_body: Tap here to log rubbish removal and pest-control visits — inspectors ask for these.
tip_stat_range_body: Choose the start and end dates to see sales for that period.
tip_stat_tiles_body: Sales, items sold, money in, and profit for the dates you picked.
tip_stat_trend_body: See how your takings rise and fall over the period.
tip_stat_top_body: See which products sell the most — and which barely move.
tip_stat_pdf_body: Tap here to download this report to share or keep.
tip_hist_date_body: Use the arrows or the calendar to choose which day's sales to see.
tip_hist_list_body: Tap any sale to open it and see the items that were sold.
tip_hist_totals_body: Number of sales, money in, and profit for the day you're viewing.
tip_hist_pdf_body: Download a full month's sales as a PDF to keep or share.
tip_low_stock_body: A few items are getting low. Tap here to check your stock and reorder.
tip_expiring_body: Some products are close to their expiry date. Tap here to see which ones.
tip_missing_cost_body: Add what you pay for each product so Movestock can show your profit. Tap here.
tip_no_sale_body: Haven't made a sale today? Tap here to ring one up — it only takes a scan.
intro_body: Tap me any time and I'll show you how to use whatever's on your screen. I'm always up here when you need a hand.
sheet_title: What can I show you here?
sheet_subtitle: I'm Stocky, your helper. Pick something and I'll point right at it.
sheet_first_open: New here? Tap any line below and I'll highlight it on your screen so you know exactly where it is.
helper_aria_tip: Stocky helper — something needs your attention
settings_desc: Let Stocky, your helper, point out features now and then. Never during a sale.
